body.name: transported Chen--Xie outcome-only comparator model
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{CX}}(P)=\mathcal U_P\cap\mathcal L_{\mathrm{out}}(P)\), with every DQM path in this intersection admissible and with target \(\theta(P)=E[h_1(W,X)-h_0(W,X)]\). The treatment-solvability locus is not imposed.
